stem: Which statement describes an effect of Jim Crow laws on transportation in the South?

options.label: A
options.text: African Americans were prohibited from buying automobiles.

options.label: B
options.text: African Americans were prohibited from owning bus companies.

options.label: C
options.text: African Americans faced seating restrictions on public buses.

options.label: D
options.text: African Americans faced seating restrictions in personal automobiles.
